crossRefs.note: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.
if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will…
I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from…
They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to…
Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will…

translations.web: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
translations.bsb: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
translations.kjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
translations.asv: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.
